title: Breathing Tax at Ojuelegba
hook: Town crier with megaphone declares FG-approved breathing tax — 500 naira per breath — at Ojuelegba bus park.

scenes.speaker: Town Crier
scenes.dialogue: Hear hear! Federal Government don approve breathing tax! Five hundred naira per breath! Pay now or hold your breath!
scenes.image_keyword: Ojuelegba bus park morning, town crier with megaphone, crowd freezing mid-step
scenes.text: Hear hear! Federal Government don approve breathing tax! Five hundred naira per breath! Pay now or hold your breath!

scenes.speaker: Mama Nkechi
scenes.dialogue: Ah! Na so? Make I stop breathe since? My pepper go spoil if I no blow air for fire!
scenes.image_keyword: Pepper seller clutching tray, wide eyes, smoke rising from grill
scenes.text: Ah! Na so? Make I stop breathe since? My pepper go spoil if I no blow air for fire!

scenes.speaker: Bros Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Oga, I be conductor. If I no breathe, who go shout 'Oshodi! Oshodi! Enter!'? My voice na my livelihood!
scenes.image_keyword: Danfo conductor hanging off bus door, hand on chest, dramatic pose
scenes.text: Oga, I be conductor. If I no breathe, who go shout 'Oshodi! Oshodi! Enter!'? My voice na my livelihood!

scenes.speaker: Student
scenes.dialogue: Sir, I dey write JAMB next week. If I hold breath, my brain go reset. You want make I fail?
scenes.caption_text: STUDENT: BRAIN NEEDS OXYGEN FOR JAMB
scenes.image_keyword: Student in uniform hugging backpack, sweating, looking skyward
scenes.text: Sir, I dey write JAMB next week. If I hold breath, my brain go reset. You want make I fail?

scenes.speaker: Corper
scenes.dialogue: Abeg, I dey serve nation. My allowance never enter. You want make I die for country wey no pay?
scenes.image_keyword: Corper in khaki, ID card flipping, empty wallet gesture
scenes.text: Abeg, I dey serve nation. My allowance never enter. You want make I die for country wey no pay?

scenes.speaker: Random Man
scenes.dialogue: My own na: I don breathe since morning. Who go calculate? You get calculator for lung?
scenes.image_keyword: Man tapping chest, pretending to count breaths on fingers
scenes.text: My own na: I don breathe since morning. Who go calculate? You get calculator for lung?

scenes.speaker: Woman with Baby
scenes.dialogue: Ehn? My pikin just born. He never even enjoy free air? Tax from day one? Na wa o!
scenes.image_keyword: Mother shielding baby, wrapper tight, indignant expression
scenes.text: Ehn? My pikin just born. He never even enjoy free air? Tax from day one? Na wa o!

scenes.speaker: Old Baba
scenes.dialogue: I don breathe seventy year free. Now una say make I pay? Na my pension una wan collect?
scenes.image_keyword: Elderly man with walking stick, hand on chest, shaking head
scenes.text: I don breathe seventy year free. Now una say make I pay? Na my pension una wan collect?

scenes.speaker: Bros Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Oga Town Crier! Bring your calculator make we see! I don breathe like twenty times since you start talk!
scenes.image_keyword: Conductor pointing at town crier, crowd forming circle
scenes.text: Oga Town Crier! Bring your calculator make we see! I don breathe like twenty times since you start talk!

scenes.speaker: Town Crier
scenes.dialogue: Calculator? Na mental maths I dey use. You think government get budget for calculator?
scenes.image_keyword: Town crier tapping temple, smug grin, megaphone lowered
scenes.text: Calculator? Na mental maths I dey use. You think government get budget for calculator?

scenes.speaker: Mama Nkechi
scenes.dialogue: Mental maths? For my ₦500 per breath? Bring POS make I tap! I no get cash!
scenes.caption_text: MAMA NKECHI: POS ONLY, NO CASH
scenes.image_keyword: Pepper seller holding out phone with POS app open, determined
scenes.text: Mental maths? For my ₦500 per breath? Bring POS make I tap! I no get cash!

scenes.speaker: LASEPA Officer
scenes.dialogue: Hold am there! LASEPA never approve any breathing tax. Who be this one with megaphone?
scenes.caption_text: LASEPA OFFICER ENTERS: NO SUCH TAX
scenes.sfx: Siren chirp, radio static, authoritative footsteps
scenes.image_keyword: LASEPA officer in reflective vest, badge visible, crowd parting
scenes.text: Hold am there! LASEPA never approve any breathing tax. Who be this one with megaphone?

scenes.speaker: Town Crier
scenes.dialogue: Oga Officer, na... na... na prank wey we dey do for TikTok! Content creation!
scenes.image_keyword: Town crier sweating, hiding megaphone behind back, phone in other hand
scenes.text: Oga Officer, na... na... na prank wey we dey do for TikTok! Content creation!

scenes.speaker: Area Boy Chairman
scenes.dialogue: TikTok? For this Ojuelegba? Boys, carry am go 'office' make e explain better. Today na 'air tax' collection day.
scenes.sfx: Motorcycle revs, chain rattle, crowd cheers
scenes.image_keyword: Area boy chairman in gold chain/shades, two boys grabbing town crier by arms
scenes.text: TikTok? For this Ojuelegba? Boys, carry am go 'office' make e explain better. Today na 'air tax' collection day.

scenes.speaker: Bros Tunde
scenes.dialogue: See? Na so e easy. Free air don return. But make una no forget — conductor money still dey!
scenes.caption_text: FREE AIR RESTORED. CONDUCTOR MONEY STAYS.
scenes.sfx: Danfo horn melody, collective exhale, Afrobeats kick
scenes.image_keyword: Conductor winking at camera, thumb up, bus park returning to chaos
scenes.text: See? Na so e easy. Free air don return. But make una no forget — conductor money still dey!

caption: When FG 'approves' breathing tax at Ojuelegba 😂 Lagos no dey carry last! Who go pay ₦500 per breath? Tag your conductor 🚐💨
